lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: They didn't make a mistake.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: The erasure. It was deliberate. Punishment.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We're docked. Salvage crew's expecting us in the hub. We move cargo, we move quiet.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: And others. There were others like me.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We know. Deep-Cache. The Collective. The question is how many more, and where they're sleeping.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: You are supposed to be dead.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Follow the red beacon. Come alone. If Dominion shows up, I burn everything, and you never learn who built you.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Well. That wasn't expected.

lines.speaker: Yard Enforcer 1
lines.text: Contact! Contact in the market! Dominion fugitive!

lines.speaker: Yard Enforcer 2
lines.text: Cut off the lower gantry! Don't let him reach the corridor!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Comms jammed! Moving to the dock authority panel!

lines.speaker: Yard Enforcer 1
lines.text: He's tearing through our line!

lines.speaker: Yard Enforcer 3
lines.text: Fall back! Fall back to the upper rig!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: This is a Dominion hold. You know that.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then we do this your way. But the moment this goes wrong, we run.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: You came alone. I'm grateful.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: My name is Tessa Rin. I was Neural Integration Specialist, Ronin Program, Dominion black-science division.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Clearance level I will not name.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then you know what it is doing to me.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Yes. I fitted the chip myself. I did it to seventeen operatives of your generation. I was proud of the work until I understood what the work was for.

lines.speaker: Dominion Servitor
lines.text: Unidentified biometric signature. Drone network engaged. Neutralize intruder.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I built them to recognize that signal. I did not think you would ever come here.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7 (recorded)
lines.text: Overseer. Kethel-7 is clear. The mission is complete.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: That's me. I reported it like a cleared floor.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: You did. And what they did to you after, that is not what you think.

lines.speaker: Dominion Guard 1
lines.text: Signature locked! Archive intruders confirmed!

lines.speaker: Dominion Guard 2
lines.text: Rappel insertion complete! Forming perimeter!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The exit's cut off! Moving deeper!

lines.speaker: Dominion Guard 1
lines.text: Contact is moving inward! Maintain pressure!

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: The chip in your skull is not a failsafe. The Dominion calls it that. It is a killswitch, a leash with a lethal end. One pulse, fired from the other side of the galaxy, and the operative drops. Clean. Final.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Yours was pulled. Days after Kethel-7, after you carried out the order, and then stopped being theirs. You broke. You ran. So they fired your switch to put you down.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: It should have killed you where you stood. It did not. It misfired, and took your memory instead of your life.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: A killswitch does not fail like that. Not on its own. Someone altered yours. That is not a malfunction.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I cannot tell you. There is a control layer above the killswitch, above my clearance. I fitted the hardware. I never saw the top of it. Whoever reached your chip reached past me.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Understand this: it is still in you. Still live. Still listening. They can try again.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I stole the killswitch schematics when I defected, I owed the operatives that much. Then I learned what the Dominion does with the ones it kills.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Erased operatives do not die. The Dominion does not waste a weapon. The body is recovered, loaded dormant into a vault, and filed away. Living weapons in cold storage. Insurance.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Seventeen that I know of, your generation. One to a vault, scattered across the galaxy. I have the manifest. I have been waiting for someone who could carry it.

lines.speaker: Dominion Guard 1
lines.text: They're ascending! Seal lower levels!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Go! Go! I'll hold them!

lines.speaker: Dominion Guard 2
lines.text: Lower section compromised! Shift to upper perimeter!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Magnetic locks engaged! Crossing to the ship!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Yard's not pursuing. We're clear for now.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: The encryption is old Dominion-military grade. You will need to work with someone who understands their cipher architecture.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Why did you stay in the yards? You could have run farther.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I needed to know if what broke in you at Kethel-7 was real, a conscience, or just the damage. I could not hand this to a malfunction.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Was it real?

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: That is the only thing I am certain of.

lines.speaker: Dominion Interceptor Pilot
lines.text: Target confirmed! Engaging pursuit!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Evasive! Now! Tessa, those guns are hot!

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: I'm, adjusting firing solution...

lines.speaker: Dominion Interceptor Pilot
lines.text: Contact lost behind wreckage! Shifting targeting grid!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Holding position! They've lost us in the shadow!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Jump coordinates locked! Now!

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Kethel-7 was not the first time something in you cracked.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Your training logs show three prior incidents.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Flagged for compassion anomalies. Buried by Khall's adjutant before they could escalate.

lines.speaker: Tessa
lines.text: Khall buried the flags, you were his finest. Kethel-7 was the one he could not bury. It did not make you refuse. It broke you.

lines.speaker: Ronin-7
lines.text: Then everything I've done since I woke, was it mercy, or just the damage talking?
